periods.description: A special Royal Officer Academy combat unit granting selected officer candidates permission to operate Drag-Rides outside ordinary practical lessons and accept military tasks for reward.
periods.principles: Students with high evaluation, sufficient Drag-Knight rank, and majority approval from current members can join; members receive privileges but must respond first to danger.
periods.classification: student combat unit / academy rapid-response squad.
periods.origin: Created due to shortage of practical Drag-Knight military personnel in the New Kingdom.
limitations: combat rewards come with high danger
